io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.settings

Class IntRangeSetting

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.ItemSetting<java.lang.Integer>
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.settings.IntRangeSetting

  • public class IntRangeSetting
extends ItemSetting<java.lang.Integer>
    This variation of ItemSetting allows you to define an Integer range and enforces this range using the validateInput(Integer) method.
    See Also:
    ItemSetting, DoubleRangeSetting
